title: On the Rate of Gaussian Approximation for Online Linear Regression Problems
abstract: arXiv:2509.14039v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this paper, we consider the problem of Gaussian approximation for the online linear regression task. We derive the corresponding rates for the setting of a constant stepsize and study the explicit dependence of the convergence rate on the problem dimension $d$ and quantities related to the design matrix. When the number of iterations $n$ is known in advance, our results yield a normal approximation rate of order $\sqrt{\log{n}/n}$, provided that the sample size $n$ is large enough.

translated_title: 关于在线线性回归问题的高斯近似速率研究
translated_abstract: 本文研究了在线线性回归任务中的高斯近似问题。我们在恒定步长的设定下推导了相应的收敛速率，并研究了该收敛速率对问题维度 $d$ 以及与设计矩阵相关量的显式依赖关系。当迭代次数 $n$ 事先已知时，只要样本量 $n$ 足够大，我们的结果给出了阶为 $\sqrt{\log{n}/n}$ 的正态近似速率。
tldr: 本文针对恒定步长下的在线线性回归问题推导了高斯近似速率，显式刻画了其对问题维度和设计矩阵相关量的依赖，并证明当样本量足够大时可获得 $\sqrt{\log{n}/n}$ 阶的正态近似速率。
en_tdlr: This paper derives Gaussian approximation rates for online linear regression with constant stepsize, explicitly characterizing the dependence on the problem dimension and design matrix, and establishes a $\sqrt{\log{n}/n}$ normal approximation rate when the sample size is sufficiently large.
